Recipe: (I believe it’s Steak and Butter Gal’s but I’m not sure. I found it in a carnivore facebook group)
Crust:
1 lb Ground Chicken
2 large eggs
½ cup grated parmesan cheese
(1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp Italian seasoning)
 
Alfredo Sauce:
½ cup heavy Cream
¼ cup butter
1 cup parm cheese
½ tsp salt
(2 tsp garlic
½ tsp Italian
½ tsp pepper)

Directions:
Preheat oven to 400, line a baking tray with parchment paper (or greased ceramic pan)

Mix crust ingredients in a bowl

Spread mixture thin on tray into whatever shape you like best (we like 2 rectangles)

Bake 25 mins (35 flipping once if you love thin crust crunchy) 

Turn oven up to 425, add sauce, cheese, and toppings

(If making alfredo pizza , combine heavy cream, parmesan cheese, & seasonings into sauce pan and stir until combined on low heat. Add sauce to pizza along with (other toppings))

Bake another 10 mins or so until cheese is melty and bubbling
